subject: Ancient History
statement: The Indus Valley Civilisation had advanced drainage systems but its script has never been deciphered.
explanation: Fact. Despite thousands of recovered seals, the Indus script remains undeciphered — unlike Brahmi or Kharosthi, which scholars have successfully read.

subject: Medieval History
statement: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by the brothers Harihara and Bukka in the 14th century.
explanation: Fact. Harihara I and Bukka I founded Vijayanagara around 1336 CE, initially as vassals of the Delhi Sultanate before asserting full independence.

subject: Modern History
statement: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
explanation: Bluff. The Congress was founded in 1885 by Allan Octavian Hume, a retired British civil servant — not Tilak, who joined the party later.

subject: Art & Culture
statement: Sattriya, the classical dance of Assam, was introduced by the Vaishnavite saint Sankaradeva.
explanation: Fact. Sattriya originated in the Vaishnavite monasteries (sattras) established by Srimanta Sankaradeva in the 15th–16th century.

subject: Geography
statement: The Tropic of Cancer passes through only two Indian states.
explanation: Bluff. It actually passes through eight states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.

subject: Economy
statement: India's GST applies a single unified tax rate to every good and service.
explanation: Bluff. GST actually has multiple tax slabs (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%), and some products like petroleum and alcohol for human consumption remain outside it entirely.

subject: Environment
statement: The Chipko Movement of the 1970s saw villagers, many of them women, hug trees to stop deforestation in the Himalayan region.
explanation: Fact. Associated with figures like Gaura Devi in Reni village and later Sunderlal Bahuguna, the movement used tree-hugging as direct, nonviolent resistance to commercial logging.

subject: Polity
statement: Fundamental Duties were not part of the original Constitution and were added later by an amendment.
explanation: Fact. Fundamental Duties (Article 51A) were inserted by the 42nd Amendment in 1976, based on recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.

subject: Ancient History
statement: Ashoka's edicts were written primarily in Sanskrit using the Devanagari script.
explanation: Bluff. Most edicts were composed in Prakrit and written in Brahmi script (Kharosthi in the northwest). Sanskrit and Devanagari became prominent much later.

subject: Polity
statement: India's Election Commission currently functions as a multi-member body, not headed solely by the Chief Election Commissioner.
explanation: Fact. The Commission currently comprises the Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners, all with equal decision-making power.
